2607.29144.title: Have I Seen You? Embedding Behavior Signals Synthetic Face Dataset Membership
2607.29144.paper_summary: Synthetic face datasets are increasingly used to reduce privacy exposure and data access constraints in biometric recognition. Yet the generators that produce these datasets are trained on real faces, so synthetic data may still reveal their real source data. We study this risk through a dataset-level membership inference attack that first identifies the synthetic dataset used to train a face recognizer and then infers the real dataset used to train the generator. Across 11 face recognition models, 11 synthetic datasets, and 7 real datasets, the attack recovers the synthetic training dataset in 100% of cases and identifies the generator's source dataset in 54.5% of cases. These results show that synthetic data can retain dataset-level traces of real training data and that privacy-preserving deployment requires stronger leakage mitigation.
2607.29144.paper_summary_zh: 合成面孔數據集越來越多地被用來減少生物識別中的隱私暴露和數據訪問限制。<lb/>然而，生成這些數據集的生成器是基於真實面孔進行訓練的，因此合成數據仍然可能揭示其真實的源數據。<lb/>我們通過一種數據集級別的成員推斷攻擊來研究這一風險，該攻擊首先識別用於訓練面孔識別器的合成數據集，然後推斷用於訓練生成器的真實數據集。<lb/>在11個面孔識別模型、11個合成數據集和7個真實數據集中，該攻擊在100%的案例中恢復了合成訓練數據集，並在54.5%的案例中識別了生成器的源數據集。<lb/>這些結果表明，合成數據可以保留真實訓練數據的數據集級別痕跡，而隱私保護的部署需要更強的洩漏緩解措施。
